description: This file defines a static extension class for IServiceCollection, providing methods to add grain storage providers to an Orleans silo configuration, including support for lifecycle participation.

classes.name: StorageProviderExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods to add grain storage providers to the IServiceCollection.

methods.name: AddGrainStorage
methods.description: Adds a grain storage provider to the service collection with optional lifecycle participation, based on the implementation type.
